name: The Unmarred Vision of Voodress
label: Quest
description: The Unmarred Vision of Voodress: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Look at it, friend! It's come alive. The spirits dance around the orb.
Give it to Maywiki so she can make one last adjustment.

clips.title: Completion
paras: One day, friend, you will be able to use this orb to communicate directly with me. Whenever this battle with Hakkar be over and Maywiki go home. Let us call to the spirits and ask them for that day to come soon.
